sections.h: A note from Joe and Alisha
p: November 2026. Working notes from June 2026, written as instructions for building the apps, and kept as written. They come from before two rules our apps now follow: we make no claims about DNA, and we don't say a sound heals or cures. These notes call Aetheria a healing system, and their names for the tones are the June ones, such as Tissue Repair for 285. Read those as where we were then. The Aetheria Tone Codex, on this shelf, has the names we use now.

sections.h: Key Mathematical Properties · Magic Square Results
p: GUT (Solfeggio): 7/8 lines = 1665. One diagonal = 1584 (off by 81 = 9²). NOT perfect.
GUT (Lo Shu Perfect 111): 8/8 lines = 1557. PERFECT magic square.
HEART: 8/8 lines = 6534. PERFECT magic square. All digit roots = 9.
HEAD: 8/8 lines = 14760. PERFECT magic square.
GUT: 111 (root 3 — Structure)
HEART: 243 = 3⁵ (root 9 — Completion)
HEAD: 354 (root 3 — Structure)
111 + 243 = 354 (HEAD = GUT + HEART)
Root sum: 3 + 9 + 3 = 15 = Lo Shu constant
HEART: ALL frequencies = root 9 (pure completion)
HEAD: cycles 3, 6, 9, 3, 6, 9, 3, 6, 9 (mirrors GUT)
Position 5 of HEART layer = 2178 Hz "Compassion Activation" (root 9)
Vertical axis: 528 (root 6) → 2178 (root 9) → 4920 (root 6)
Pattern: Harmony → Completion → Harmony
The Solfeggio scale is the perfect 111-interval sequence + structured offsets:
Positions 4-6: +9 (= 9 × 1)
Positions 7-9: +0 (exact match)
